chose: the engine forgets a leaver's words as a memberLeft subscriber, published in the directory's mutation
over: the directory scheduling the engine's purge itself
because: AT7 asks the directory's mutation to schedule the purge; the bus already publishes memberLeft there, so the directory stays unaware of the engine and the purge gets the member's ID only (#240)

chose: the purge removes every stored words row of the author or workspace, with no time bound
over: bounding the purge to rows created before the leave or the request
because: a creation-time bound misses a row whose insert commits after the leaving mutation started, and convex-test stamps rows a fraction after Date.now(); missing a row would resurrect a departed member's words on rejoin, while the unbounded purge can only catch a rejoined member's brand-new kudos during the seconds the pages run (#240, AT7, AT8)
binding: none: this session owns no active work order

chose: the maintainer runs forgetWordsOfMember and forgetWordsOfWorkspace live in convex/workspace/wordDeletion.ts, declared as Workspace entrances
over: declaring them in the Slack component
because: AT8 offers Slack or Workspace; the deletion is about the workspace's people, not a Slack call, and the leave purge already starts from the directory, so both starts sit beside it (#240)

chose: wordsOf answers removed for a words row whose author the directory knows as no longer a member
over: leaving the author check to the activity module (#241)
because: AT7 makes the words unreadable at once, before the purge runs; wordsOf is the one read every reader builds on, so the suppression cannot be forgotten by a later reader (#240, AT27)

because: those tombstones hold no words, so there is nothing to remove, and AT8 says a deletion request does not stop the app storing later kudos (#240)
